create_timer_instance: create a Timer instance that starts tracking elapsed time from initialization
get_time_since_start: get the formatted elapsed time string since the Timer was started
reset_timer: reset the Timer to restart elapsed time tracking from the current moment
get_unix_time_since_start: get the elapsed time since start as a Unix timestamp in seconds or milliseconds
format_time_gap: format a time gap in milliseconds into a human-readable hours, minutes, seconds, and milliseconds string
